{"reason":"Adds the unused high-confidence gate, rejecting six of eight listed false-arbitration rows with confidence below 0.7 while retaining the magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon checks. This should materially reduce v1’s 0.714 false-arbitration rate with less recall risk than tightening exposure, preserving the business gate.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
